answer: The quill holds work receipts rather than names, so the sable of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The anchor of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
